sloka: यस्मिम्स्तु सर्वे स्युरसन्निविष्टा ।धर्मो यतः स्यात् तदुपक्रमेत ।द्वेष्यो भवत्यर्थपरो हि लोके ।कामात्मता खल्वपि न प्रशस्ता ॥२-२१-५७॥
transliteration: yasmimstu sarve syurasanniviṣṭā ।dharmo yataḥ syāt tadupakrameta ।dveṣyo bhavatyarthaparo hi loke ।kāmātmatā khalvapi na praśastā ॥2-21-57॥

translations.english: If actions which combine these three (dharma, artha and kama), cannot be performed (which is likely), resort to righteousness. (For) one who seeks wealth is abhorred and one who seeks fulfilment of desires does not attract admiration in this world.
